intro: A Student of Nature marks a fledgling druid's introduction to formal training on Zephras Isle. After helping restore local harmony, novice druids are summoned by Xyton Silverwind beneath the boughs of Thendal Grove. It serves as the opening gateway into understanding the deeper balance between flora and fauna on the isle.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident adventurer trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.
Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, I am Xyton Silverwind, keeper of druidic lore.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The flora and fauna of Zephras Isle represent a rich tapestry of vibrant life. The ecosystem requires constant balance to maintain the harmony of nature, and we adventurers are the keepers of that balance. I see much potential in you, but this path is not an easy one, and you will need guidance as you grow in strength as a student of the fang, the claw, the friend, and the branch.
Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
